answer: The anchor schedule is applied in ridge and mirror shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3441 identities would post 2432 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
